title: Soil - Bearing Strength
description: Allowable loads on soil. Reference table for bearing strength of various soil types measured in kPa (kiloPascals).

components.content:
### Notes

- **1 kPa** = 1 kN/m² = 10³ N/m²
- Always check local building codes before designing foundations
- Bearing strength values shown are allowable loads and should be verified with site-specific soil testing
